name: Judas
overview: The Scriptures reveal Judas primarily as Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve apostles who notoriously betrayed Jesus to the chief priests for thirty pieces of silver, fulfilling the painful prophecy of a trusted friend turning against the Messiah (Psalms 41:9; Matthew 26:14, 26:47). His remorse after Jesus' condemnation led him to return the silver and ultimately take his own life by hanging (Matthew 27:3, 27:5). Jesus had foretold this betrayal during the Last Supper, underscoring the gravity of Judas's actions within the unfolding redemptive plan (Mark 14:18).
